gold: Wellens syndrome with critical left anterior descending coronary artery stenosis

selector.rationale: Intermittent compression-like chest pain and ECG changes with deeply inverted T-waves in leads V2 to V4, along with total occlusion at the ostium of the left anterior descending coronary artery, best support Acute Coronary Syndrome without strong contradictions.

rejected.why: Normal high-sensitivity troponin levels contradict myocardial infarction

rejected.label: Hypertensive Heart Disease
rejected.why: While hypertension is present, it does not directly explain the acute chest pain and ECG findings

rejected.label: Diabetic Cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: Diabetes history is noted, but the presentation is more consistent with an acute coronary event than cardiomyopathy
